config.defaultFormat.description: Default archive format used when compressing files.
config.defaultFormat.tar.gz: TAR + GZip — compressed archive with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.bz2: TAR + BZip2 — high compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.xz: TAR + XZ — best compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.zst: TAR + Zstandard — fast compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.lz4: TAR + LZ4 — fastest compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.br: TAR + Brotli — high compression ratio with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.sz: TAR + Snappy — fastest compression with directory structure
config.maxFileSize.description: Maximum allowed size for a single decompressed file. Supports units: k/m/g (e.g. '100m', '1g', '500k'). Integer values treated as MiB for backward compatibility. Default: '1g' (= 1 GiB).
config.maxTotalSize.description: Maximum total decompressed size across all files. Supports units: k/m/g (e.g. '10g', '1g', '500m'). Integer values treated as MiB for backward compatibility. Default: '10g' (= 10 GiB).
config.collapsedDirPatterns.description: Directory name patterns to keep collapsed by default in the archive preview.
config.compressExcludePatterns.descripti: Glob patterns (gitignore syntax) for files/directories to exclude when compressing.
config.volumeSizes.description:
Custom split volume size presets (label → value).

**Keys**: display labels shown in the size picker (e.g. `"650M"`, `"1.44M"`).

**Values**: must be a **positive integer** followed by a **unit**:
- `k` — KiB (e.g. `"1440k"`)
- `m` — MiB (e.g. `"25m"`, `"100m"`)
- `g` — GiB (e.g. `"1g"`, `"2g"`)

Decimals and negative numbers are not valid (e.g. `"1.5m"`, `"-100m"` ✗).

Leave empty `{}` to use the built-in presets.
config.useSystem7z.description: Which 7-Zip engine to use for compress/decompress. A native 7-Zip is bundled with the extension (no install needed); a system install or the WASM engine can be selected instead. Native is significantly faster and uses less memory than WASM.
config.useSystem7z.auto: Prefer a system 7-Zip (v21+) if installed, otherwise use the native 7-Zip bundled with the extension. The WASM engine is used only if no native binary is available for this platform.
config.useSystem7z.always: Always use system 7-Zip. Show an error if 7-Zip is not installed or too old.
config.useSystem7z.bundled: Always use the 7-Zip binary bundled with this extension, ignoring any system installation. Falls back to the WASM engine if the bundled binary is unavailable for this platform.
config.useSystem7z.never: Never use a native 7-Zip (system or bundled). Always use the bundled WASM engine, even if a native 7-Zip is available.
config.useSystemZstd.description: Whether to use a system-installed zstd binary for tar.zst compression. System zstd is faster, but requires a local installation.
config.useSystemZstd.auto: Detect system zstd automatically. If found, use it for faster tar.zst compression; otherwise fall back to bundled zstd-wasm.
config.useSystemZstd.always: Always use system zstd. Show an error if zstd is not installed.
config.useSystemZstd.never: Never use system zstd. Always use the bundled zstd-wasm engine, even if zstd is installed.
